title: GoodMC: Items
description: Adds the items and gear the original GoodMC mod made for Minecraft 1.12.2 did
body:
GoodMC: Items is a small mod that can function as an Addon for GoodMC which restores the 1.7/1.8 combat system including the iconic 1.7 animations (See mod GoodMC on my CurseForge page [HERE](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/goodmc-old-combat-blockhitting) or my Modrinth page [HERE](https://modrinth.com/mod/goodmc-old-combat)).

GoodMC: Items can be installed completely separately. Installing GoodMC is NOT required in order to install this mod.

The original version of GoodMC, made for Minecraft 1.12.2, added a few items and gear to the game that the newer versions of it do not.

The items include:
- Notch Armor (Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings & Boots)
- Notch Sword
- Notch Tools (Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, Hoe)

And even the Notch Apple Block

All these items are crafted using Enchanted Golden Apples (AKA Notch Apples), and sticks for the tools & sword, in the same pattern as Vanilla Minecraft.

If you like the mod, please consider donating on my Ko-fi page. Your support is really appreciated:
https://ko-fi.com/buvtack

**The mod even comes with a built-in Programmer Art-like resource pack! Perfect for those who want to have the classic GoodMC experience.**

![The items from GoodMC: Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a68ddcf149ec8da803b8196400133cac77dca0c0.png)

The mod even adds a few other surprises... But I'll leave those as easter eggs!
